name: Cilissa
description: A Setessan warrior on Theros, an orphan with a bond to the goddess Karametra.

description_citations.text: "Cilissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At six, Cilissa is brought to Setessa as an orphan and receives a vision of Karametra.
timeline.quote: A vision of Karametra hovered in the starfield of Nyx above Cilissa

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karametra's sparks create glowing pods whose warmth brings Cilissa memories of her parents' fall to Akroan attackers.
timeline.quote: Her father fell to the first wave of Akroan attackers.

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At nine, Cilissa spars with Thora and then Niketa, who tells her to be more aggressive.
timeline.quote: It was not enough to simply be the strongest or the fastest.

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At fourteen, Cilissa and Thora say farewell to Kelios on his peregrination, and Thora is furious with Cilissa.
timeline.quote: Thora was furious with Cilissa when Kelios left

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At eighteen, the Nyxborn attack Setessa in droves and Cilissa helps defend the city.
timeline.quote: the Nyxborn were all attacking Setessa in droves

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cilissa kills the gorgon with her axe and lures a minotaur into cleaving open Karametra's pod, dissolving all Nyxborn.
timeline.quote: All the Nyxborn slowly dissolved into nothingness.

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Months later, Cilissa welcomes a new group of orphaned children with Karametra's voice.
timeline.quote: She let her voice be infused by the presence of Karametra

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Trainer who spars with and coaches her.
relations.quote: The trainer, Niketa , helped her up
